title: Sarah's Promised Baby
reflectionQuestion: God kept his promise and filled Sarah's home with laughter. What is something that fills your home with happy laughter?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Abraham & Sarah, secondary/short-only). The JOY/laughter register (feedback_kid_four_registers) + female-led. A long-awaited baby (Isaac = 'laughter') after old age -- 'is anything too hard for God?' + 'God always keeps his promises'. Distinct from 1823 God Calls Abraham (Gen 12, the call) -- this is the promise kept (Gen 18 + 21). Sarah's doubt-laugh turns to joy-laugh, handled gently (not scolded). Indelible image = old Sarah holding baby Isaac, eyes shining with happy tears; the once-quiet tent full of a baby's sound. 'God' throughout, no Yahweh. VOICE_ARABELLA (tender nurturer) -- mother/baby warmth.
